---
name: Bug report
about: Report unexpected behavior for investigation and SpecDD triage
title: "bug: "
labels: bug
---

## Actual and expected behavior

Describe both. Include the applicable docs/specs rule, or write "Unknown".

## Reproduction

Minimal configuration and steps, with secrets and state removed.

## Impact

Who is affected, severity, frequency and available workaround.

## Environment

Provider, Terraform, GoAlert and operating-system versions.

## Evidence

Sanitized diagnostics and relevant test results. Never paste tokens, complete
state files, private URLs containing credentials or signing material.

## Triage (maintainer)

Track, rationale, owner, canonical spec, milestone and scheduling decision.
Intake is not automatic acceptance or a P0 classification.
